The top prize count on "50th Anniversary" has not moved for two weeks. The game still has one of three top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

The second-biggest prize left on "50th Anniversary" is $1 million, with three of them remaining.

Everything here about "50th Anniversary" comes from official Ohio lottery numbers, current through November 2.
827.headline: Top prizes are still unclaimed

847.body:
All the top prizes on "Bingo 50X" have been claimed. That lowers the biggest prize from $500,000 to $100,000. There are two of those left. The prize table has today's count for every prize level.

Everything above about "Bingo 50X" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
847.headline: Top prize already claimed

891.body:
"Cash Explosion 25X" has 83,876 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with one left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If you play "Cash Explosion 25X" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
